name: number-flow
title: Number Flow
description: An animated number: digits roll, signs and symbols fade and the width eases when the value changes, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat, as a React wrapper over NumberFlow.
label: NumberFlow
author: Maxwell Barvian <https://github.com/barvian>

props.name: value
props.description: The number to show. Change it to animate; a decimal string is formatted exactly.

props.name: format / locales
props.description: Formatting, as Intl.NumberFormat takes it (currency, percent, compact, units, sign display). Most options are supported; see NumberFlow's documentation for the exceptions.

props.name: prefix / suffix
props.description: Text before and after the number ("/mo"), part of its accessible name.

props.name: trend
props.description: Which way digits spin: 1 up, -1 down, 0 each digit on its own (by its own change).

props.name: plugins
props.description: `[continuous]` makes a change pass through the numbers in between (exported as `continuous`).

props.name: animated
props.description: false shows changes at once and finishes running animations.

props.name: respectMotionPreference
props.description: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, changes show at once. Leave it on.

props.name: transformTiming / spinTiming / opacityTiming
props.default: 900 ms spring-like curve / transformTiming / 450 ms ease-out
props.description: Timing of the slide and resize, the digit spin and the fades.

props.name: digits
props.description: Per-position digit limits (for example `{ 1: { max: 5 } }` for minutes and seconds). Not reactive.

props.name: isolate / willChange
props.description: Do not move with sibling layout changes; hint `will-change` for numbers that change often.

props.name: onAnimationsStart / onAnimationsFinish
props.description: Called when a change starts and finishes animating.

props.name: announce
props.description: Labs addition: also announces each new value through a polite live region. The number is always named by its value; this makes changes heard.

props.name: format.numberingSystem
props.description: NumberFlow draws only the digits 0 to 9. A number whose numbering system is not "latn" (ar-EG and fa-IR default to their own digits) is shown as plain text without the animation; pass `format={{ numberingSystem: "latn" }}` to animate it.

props.name: NumberFlowGroup
props.description: Wrap numbers that move each other (a price beside its change) so their transitions stay in sync.

props.name: useCanAnimate
props.description: Whether NumberFlow can animate in this browser and motion setting (false on the server).

a11y: NumberFlow names itself: the element has role img and an accessible name equal to the formatted value with its prefix and suffix ("$1,240.50"), set through ElementInternals; the server markup carries the same role and label. The rolling digits are not read one by one.
A change of that name is not announced. Set `announce` for a value the reader should hear change; it adds a polite, atomic live region with the new value (it is then also present in browse mode).
Pass `aria-label` for more context ("Balance: $1,240.50"); an explicit attribute takes precedence over NumberFlow's own name, so keep it in step with the value.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the value changes without animation (respectMotionPreference, on by default). Changes in a hidden tab or off screen do not animate either.

The number is laid out left to right (direction: ltr) in every language, as numerals are; locales that use other digits (ar-EG, fa-IR) are formatted by Intl. The demo's change is signed (+/−), so its color is not the only cue.
